posts.title: Fall update including the Winnipeg Comic Con!
posts.description: Well it’s been a fun filled fall season so far! Halloween weekend saw us head to Manitoba and to the Winnipeg Comic Con for the first time ever. I was fortunate to be a creator guest this year and found myself in some pretty spectacular company in artist alley. posts.title: Interview time!
posts.description: So at the end of July I ended up doing an in studio, live on air interview on The Evan Bray Show on 650 CKOM/980 CJME. This was a lot of fun and took me into a studio I haven’t been to yet. Evan was great and it was a fun time! Take a listen below! Here is the link to the episode: https://iono.fm/e/1701429 Stay tooned for more fun updates!
